title: Bookings from email into a verifiable itinerary
description: See which parts of the email carried over, what is missing and what has to be fixed by hand.

blocks.text: A person forgets where they booked the different parts of a trip. A forwarded email helps gather them, until an import failure with no explanation forces checking everything by hand.

quote.text: I have been using this app for more than 10 years. Love how it keeps all your travel data in one place. I can no longer remember which portal I booked which segment at, but tripit keeps it all in one place for me.

blocks.text: Every email is linked to the dates, places and participants extracted from it. A failed transfer is visible; the entry can be corrected while the original confirmation is kept for comparison.
What decides whether it is useful

It makes sense to limit the first version to certain types of confirmation. The main test is a booking that was missed or changed, not a demonstration of a flawless example. This could also be an improvement to an organizer someone already uses.
